scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Jingle Bells! Jingle Bells! Jingle all the way!
O' what fun it is to ride in a one-horse open sleeeigh, Hey!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Merry Christmas!
Hey! You! What comes to mind when you think about Christmas?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Jingle Bells! Jingle Bells! Jingle all the way!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: O' what fun it is to ride in a one-horse open sleigh!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Merry Christmas!
Hey, boy! What comes to mind when
you think about Christmas?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Merry Christmas!
Hey, girl! What comes to mind when
you think about Christmas?
Santa Claus
Gift Boxes
Carols
Santa Costumes
Fake Santa Antonio

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Santa Claus!
You're so innocent!!
Ah!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Here's a secret!
There's a rumor that Santa Claus lives in a certain village all throughout the year.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
But now!!!
In this Christmas season!!
You guys can meet Santa on either of the five possible villages throughout Rune-Midgerts!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: If you win over Santa, you can get a gift. Would you go for it?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
Isn't that big news?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Gift boxes?! All right!
Isn't it thrilling to open gifts over your head!!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Anyway, did you know...
Some villain, a fake Santa robbed some gifts from the good Santa!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Furthermore, he has put bad magic on the gifts so that they become monsters!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
Isn't it amazing?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Ah, a music box is useful.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Though we can't all play it around the village as we planned, it's cool that you carry it.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: We want to enjoy carols all together... I hope to get Crystal Pieces!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
Why not? Sure, I can give you some.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Yes, please.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Wow, you have them.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: I can bake you a cake, and I can carve your name on the cake, if you want!
No, thanks.
Please name it for me.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Thank for your help!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Many people live in the giant world!
So many people hope to hear Caroller, yet I always lack Crystal pieces.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Let's care about others around you on this Christmas season!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Oh!
Shyness!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Anyway, thanks a lot for your help.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Many people live in the giant world!
So many people hope to hear Caroller, yet I always lack Crystal pieces.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Let's care about others around you on this Christmas season!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
You know about Christmas!
Talking about Christmas...
...it's carols!!!
I've been waiting for this for when
Christmas comes around!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: But there's been no caroling here and there like before, so we can't feel the Christmas spirit.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: So, I installed a Singing Crystal in Prontera...

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: but that jerk Antonio broke the crystal!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: The gift boxes have been changing into monsters since Antonio placed some magic on them, so the monsters ate up the crystal fragments!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: I am so devastated, since the Singing Crystal has been the hope of many children around the villages.
There's no other way to carol?
You can hear carols in Lutie.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: And just stay there, every Christmas, for your whole life?
What? What do you mean?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Oh, nevermind.
Ah...

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Maybe, it's quite hard to make a jukebox for the villages, but a music box might be possible.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: We need the ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 that the monsters ate up.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000FF6 Singing Crystal Pieces^000000, and you will be rewarded with presents!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Sounds cool, huh!!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: ...Why are you staring at me like that?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: You're thinking that we are always getting our plans spoiled, aren't you?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: I know that we are not good at controlling stuff, but our rewards are good, right?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Hey, we treat you good...

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
You are so cruel to me!
Bad! Bad!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Please, for our children's hope!!!?
Please bring me 6 Singing Crystal Pieces from ^0000FFViolent Gift Boxes^000000!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
They're definitely as harsh as their name.
Go on please!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Santa costumes!!
You know, the santa costumes that the monsters are wearing now aren't genuine!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: The rumor 'round here is, Lutie's designer made these costumes.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Every year, adventurers challenge to attack Antonio the fake Santa, but there's no way to catch up to him due to his hat and costume!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Are there some special abilities within them?
There's still the designer in the Christmas village... How about asking her to make that costume?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
It's hot, huh?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
A-N-T-O-N-I-O!!!
As I heard, this Antonio is quite different from before.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: He seems to be quite resolved with himself since he ran away from people before.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: And he isn't alone anymore... is what I heard...

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
Hotness, right?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Maybe, it's quite hard to make a jukebox for the villages, but a music box might be possible.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: We need the ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 that the monsters ate up.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000FF6 Singing Crystal Pieces^000000, and you will be rewarded with presents!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
For all of the children of this world!!!
Please bring me ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 from ^0000FFViolent Gift Boxes^000000!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Be careful!
They're definitely as harsh as their name.
Take care!!!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Don't cry, don't cry!
Santa won't give you a gift if you're crying.
I got them!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Wow, you got them!
They are so cruel, aren't they?
I'm happy to see you again.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Let's count together!
... ...
Six!!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: All right! We can start to make our music box with crystal fragments.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: We would amplify the sounds of the crystal fragments to sound through the music box.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: You know, a music box that sounds like a jukebox!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
It's handy. You can carry it, as well as listen to sweet carols anywhere.
Doesn't that sound cool!?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
So, we need more of some materials.
^0000FF10 Trunk, 1 Hammer Of Blacksmith, 1 Jubilee, 10 Sticky Mucus, 3carat Diamond^000000!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Those are all needed.
Isn't that easy?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
We can make a music box with Singing Crystal Pieces.
It's handy, you can hear carols anywhere. Sounds cool?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
So, we need more of some materials.
^0000FF10 Trunk, 1 Hammer Of Blacksmith, 1 Jubilee, 10 Sticky Mucus, 3carat Diamond^000000!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
That's all we need.
Isn't that easy?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Jingle bells, jingle bells,
jingle all the way!
O what fun it is to ride, in a
one... horse... o-pen... sleigh!!!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Wow!
You came back!
Did you bring all the materials?

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Good!
No need to hesitate! Let's get started to make our music box.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Blacksmith hammers on trunk... and we shape the frame.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Please use the Singing Crystal Pieces for a column, the Diamond as a prop, and the Sticky Mucus as glue.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
And now...
we decorate with a Jubilee...

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
The last step...!
Breating life into it!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: It's done now!!!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: It's so cool! Isn't it cute!!?!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: You did as I requested, so I will give you gifts, as promised.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
One, is this music box.
Please play this music box all over the villages!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Another present is a Christmas cake especially shaped like your name!
I made this cake shaped like your name!

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text: Don't worry, it tastes good.

scripts.speaker: Caroller
scripts.text:
Thanks a lot.
Merry Christmas!
Have a good holiday season!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
Wow! Were you naughty or nice this year?
All right, what comes to your mind when you think about Christmas?
Carolling
Santa Claus
Gift Boxes
Santa Costume
Not much really...

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
Carolling! That's good!
A sweet carol always makes Christmas more happy!!!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Yes indeed Carolling spreads Joy throughout the world?

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Ho ho ho! What a good boy!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Ho ho ho! What a good girl!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
But you should be wary of a fake Santa romaing around.
Have you heard of Antonio, who invades villages every Christmas?

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: He has stolen my gifts, as well as attacked adventurers around Toy and Lutie field.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
A bad Santa ruins us good Santa's reputations!
The World Santa Organization is considering this a grave situation.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
A gift box! That sounds good!
It's so exciting to open gift boxes when you wake up on Christmas morning!!!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: But we have very little gifts now, since Santa Antonio has stolen my gift bag.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Many adventurers try to catch up to him, but he is not easy to catch.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Anyway let those adventurers try to catch him, I have a small game for you.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: I will give you a small gift if you beat me!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Do you want to play a game with me?
No, thanks.
Yes, I would.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
Aww, don't be afraid.
If you've been a little naughty this year I won't stuff your stockings with coal.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: I will stay here throughout the Christmas season, just visit me when you change your mind.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Um... You've played the game recently haven't you?

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
You can try the game once a hour.
Please visit me after the one hour has passed.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Wow! You're so cool!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Let me explain how to play this game.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
It's quite simple.
I will pick one of three cards: Poring Card, Ghostring Card, and Angeling Card.
Guess which card I pick and you're a winner!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
If you guess right 3 times out of 5, I will give you a gift.
Let's get started!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: First let me shuffle up these cards... Ok!!!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: One!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Two!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Three!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: I'm picking up only one!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
I'm picking up only one!
Please guess what is is.
Poring
Angeling
Ghostring
Um...I choose Poring!
Um...I choose Angeling!
Um...I choose Ghostring!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
Let's see!!
One! Two! Three!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
Let's see!!
One! Two! Three!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
You're lucky.
Can you guess the right card the next time around?

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Aww maybe next time...

This is just luck.
Let me try again!!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: Whenever you want.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text: You're so good!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
Now this gift is for you.
Put your hand into the bag and pick only one.

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
Good job! Thanks for playing the card game with me!
Merry Christmas!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
Do you mean that ever so fashionable costume for Santa's and youngsters!?!
Light-weight, fashionable, and keeps you warm!

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
There used to be designer who visited my house to make my Santa costumes.
Do you have any ideas?

scripts.speaker: Santa Claus
scripts.text:
You should open your heart to the spirit of Christmas!
Once you do, I know you'll be able to think of something.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
I always thought about how boring Santa Claus is wearing a too boring costume.
Too boring!

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text: I could make a glamorous style for him!

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
I once made a costume for the notorious figure Antonio!
The reason catching up to him is so hard, is that his clothes have been given strong power!
I blessed them with good luck!

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
Preta Porter!!
Which is quite luxurious but sold at good price ~

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
Hey loosers!
You can share my sense of fashion and wear my look if you run a light mission for me.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text: Are you interested?
Nope.
Yes, please.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
Ah!
You're silly! You lost your big chance!

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
Come to me later if you want to get the mission.
I, Louise Kim, am generous enough to accept you next time.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text: You're so cool.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
Don't worry about this mission.
It's not that difficult.
I'm only in need of some materials. Things that are beyond my ability...

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text: Anyway, can you bring me some stuff?
Why not? What do you need?
Sorry, no time.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
What?
You will definitely regret it.
No more chances later.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
All right, you're cool!!
You need to bring me: ^0000FFCotton Shirt, 3 Red Potion, Holy Water, 4 Wrapping Paper, Wrapping Lace^000000.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text: If you bring me all that stuff, I can make you a glamorous Santa costume.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text: If you were to bring me all the stuff, I would make you a wonderful costume, for free...

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text: Please see me again if you are interested.
Here you are.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
Oh! Good!
Let's not delay.
I will show you my limitless ability.

-She pours everything in a pot-
-even the shirt goes in!-
-She takes it out with skill-
-and many blessings she sings.-

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
By artist, Louise Kim!
All over the world will be blessed tonight!

-Pour red potion in another pot-
-then stir all of its parts.-
-Put the cotton shirts in-
-and dye it for grateful hearts.-
-Thread by thread-
-String by string-
-Count your blessings and sing!-

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
By artist, Louise Kim!
All over the world will be blessed tonight!

-She is knitting clothes-
-with a hooked needle-
-with her great skill.-
-Spread your blessings,-
-cheer and goodwill!-

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
This is miraculous!
I am a genius of the world.
Artist, Louise Kim!!!

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text:
All right! Isn't it wonderful?
You can call it what you wish.
My fashion is radiant.
I ain't envious of Designer Pierre.

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text: I am supposed to get paid well, however I will just let it be free, since this is Christmas!

scripts.speaker: Louise Kim
scripts.text: Go brag about these wonderful clothes. There wouldn't be any without me, Louise Kim.
